name: Preacher
ability: Each night, choose a player: a Minion, if chosen, learns this. All chosen Minions have no ability.
designRole: Chosen Minions learn this and lose their abilities, reducing evil utility.
explanation: Chosen Minions learn this and lose their abilities, reducing evil utility.

nightInstructions.firstNight: The Preacher chooses a player. :reminder: If they chose a Minion: Put the Preacher to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Preacher tokens.
nightInstructions.otherNights: The Preacher chooses a player. :reminder: If they chose a Minion: Put the Preacher to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Preacher tokens.

jinxes.reason: If the Preacher chooses Legion, Legion keeps their ability, but the Preacher might learn they are Legion.
If the living Summoner has no ability, the Storyteller has the Summoner ability.
If the Vizier loses their ability, they learn this, and cannot die during the day.
